swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB uses TO-263-5 (5-pin, KTT) while TPS54302DDCR uses SOT-23-6 (6-pin, DDC); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VIN vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs VIN), Pin 6 (NONE vs BOOT). Soldering TPS54302DDCR onto a LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (TO-263-5: GND vs SOT-23-6: NONE); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.
CRITICAL ENABLE POLARITY: Active-High vs Active-Low EN pin mismatch — existing MCU GPIO or pull-up/pull-down resistor will invert regulator ON/OFF state.
HIGH RECTIFICATION DIFFERENCE: LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB is non-synchronous and requires an external Schottky catch/freewheeling diode, whereas the counterpart integrates a synchronous low-side MOSFET.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 63% (LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB: 150 kHz p.7 vs TPS54302DDCR: 400 kHz p.5); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB: 33 µH p.25 vs TPS54302DDCR: 10 µH p.18); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH FEEDBACK CONFIGURATION: One converter is fixed-output while the other is adjustable; external R1/R2 feedback resistors and feedforward capacitor must be updated.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB: 40 V p.6 vs TPS54302DDCR: 28 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 58% (LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB: 50 °C/W p.5 vs TPS54302DDCR: 118.9 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB (Texas Instruments, TO-263-5) and TPS54302DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VIN vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs VIN), Pin 6 (NONE vs BOOT); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Key datasheet deltas: topology is buck (non-sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency is 150 kHz (p.7) vs 400 kHz (p.5), rated current is 3000 mA (p.1) vs 3000 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 33 µH (p.25) vs 10 µH (p.18), and Iq is 5000 µA (p.7) vs 45 µA (p.5). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.4 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 50 vs 118.9 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
